description: This file defines an abstract class 'KintObject' that serves as a base for objects related to variable inspection or debugging, with properties for variable type and value, and an abstract parse method.

classes.name: KintObject
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for variable inspection objects, providing properties for type and value, and declaring an abstract 'parse' method.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: An abstract method intended to process a variable and return either false or an associative array representing different tabs in a view.
